description:
What should you do if a moose charges? Alaska's Department of Fish and Game says more people in Alaska are injured by moose than by bears each year. A charging moose often kicks forward with its front hooves. Unlike with bears, running is usually a good idea because a moose won't chase you very far, and if one knocks you down, curl up, protect your head and hold still until it moves a safe distance away.

#moose #alaska #meatballmyths #shorts

Sources: Alaska Department of Fish and Game (Aggressive Moose); U.S. National Park Service (Moose Safety). General information, not safety training.
